verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own rule-like automation on incoming event data. Forwarding rules conditionally control whether events reach downstream outputs (e.g. 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present'). Audiences built from user behavior, once connected to an output, are activated automatically. It also offers data transformation as events enter and leave, and claims it will suggest audience and journey logic from a natural-language description. However, none of this is documented as a general event-triggered rules/actions engine; it is filtering, forwarding and audience activation rather than arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: an explicit event-trigger → action rule builder, documentation of the types of actions rules can fire, evidence that the AI-assisted logic produces executable automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
